visualCharacteristics.purpose: slider; default shows one slide with a text panel, brands shows a looping strip of portrait brand images with label links
visualCharacteristics.layout: brands: full-bleed, 475x563 slides, ~3 visible with neighbours peeking, 45px white round arrows, 10px dots

contentPattern.structure: one row per slide: image | content (default: heading, text, buttons; brands: one link whose text is the brand label)

reuseGuidance: Brands: put the "Brands" section heading above the block as default content (use the center section style). Each slide needs an image and one link; the image links to the same URL. Arrows wrap around; arrow keys move the slider when it has focus.
